feedback_by_option.en: Being familiar food does not tell you the listed part; the card lists leaves.

feedback_by_option.fil: Dahon ng Momordica charantia ang nasa card; hindi ito dose.
feedback_by_option.en: The card lists leaves of Momordica charantia; this is not a dose.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tingnan ang botanical name at bahagi sa card, hindi lang ang sinasabi ni Joel.
feedback_by_option.en: Check the botanical name and part on the card, not only what Joel says.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi awtomatikong kapalit ng diabetes plan ang pagkain; maaaring maantala ang pangangalaga.
feedback_by_option.en: Food is not an automatic substitute for a diabetes plan; care may be delayed.

feedback_by_option.fil: Ang clinician na sumusubaybay sa blood sugar at gamot ni Joel ang magpapasya.
feedback_by_option.en: The clinician monitoring Joel’s blood sugar and medicines decides.

feedback_by_option.fil: Pagbabago ng gamot ang pagbabawas; ang clinician lamang niya ang magpapasya.
feedback_by_option.en: Taking less medicine is a medication change; only his clinician decides.
